comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus selectively remove one chip from an open packet while retaining the others.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires fine rotary tool engagement and iterative tuning; record performs selective grasp/extraction through a constrained mouth, potentially stabilizing the packet while avoiding neighboring items.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two qualified impacts; record requires exactly one chip on the plate, two still contained, hands clear, and no packet displacement, excessive tilt, or dropped chip.
comparison.reason: Selective retrieval and retention are materially different from damper commissioning. Candidate response and drift thresholds are not fully numeric.
